added.summary: background and background-image take url() layers beside gradients: an atlas icon by name or a texture by its asset handle, each with a position, size and repeat (CSS Backgrounds 3), and background-size, background-position and background-repeat as comma lists over the layers. border-radius and clip-path cut them.
An image fill sized (cover, contain, given or auto from the texture's own size), placed and repeated per axis (repeat, no-repeat, space, round) as a CSS background layer.
